draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.22, the 79th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 5th of 18 at TE. He lasted until pick 128, well after his grade rank (79th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Cole Kmet. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2021) ranked 3rd in receiving yards among the 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers. 47 career games and 13 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (2 AV) was his best yet. Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 142 receiving yards against a median of 179, below the norm.
